data.name: Aftabia
data.gender_notes: Aftabia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The radiant one, the shining star, the one who appears before the sun. The name Aftabia carries the meaning “Morning Star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Aftabia usually hope their child will grow to embody morning star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and renewal, the light that shines in the darkness
data.etymology: Aftabia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Morning Star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aftabia total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أفتابية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من افتاب، يعني ضياء و نور
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أفتابية مشتق من كلمة افتاب التي تعني ضياء و نور، و هو اسم يعني الشخص الذي يمتلك ضوء و نور في حياته، و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم العديد من الآيات التي تشير إلى أهمية الضوء و النور في الحياة، مثل قوله تعالى: 'والنور الذي أنزلنا' (الآية 1 من سورة النور)، و في السنة النبوية، قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه و سلم: 'أنت نور الله في الأرض'.

in_urdu.name: آفتابیہ
in_urdu.meaning: آفتاب سے ماخوذ، روشنی اور نور کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: آفتابیہ نام آفتاب سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے روشنی اور نور، یہ نام اس شخص کو دیا جاتا ہے جو اپنی زندگی میں روشنی اور نور کا باعث بنتا ہے، اور اسلامی تقالید میں روشنی اور نور کی اہمیت کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں کیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ نور میں، اور سنی حدیث میں رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم نے कहा: 'تو اللہ کی زمین پر نور ہو'.

in_hindi.name: आफ़ताबिया
in_hindi.meaning: आफ़ताब से लिया गया, प्रकाश और ज्योति का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: आफ़ताबिया नाम आफ़ताब से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश और ज्योति, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति को दिया जाता है जो अपने जीवन में प्रकाश और ज्योति का स्रोत बनता है, और इस्लामी परंपरा में प्रकाश और ज्योति का महत्व قرآن कريم में उल्लेख किया गया है, जैसे कि सूरा नूर में, और सुन्नत में रसूल अल्लाह صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم ने कहा: 'तुम अल्लाह की धरती पर नूर हो'.

in_pashto.name: آفتابيا
in_pashto.meaning: د آفتاب څخه اخیستل شوی، د رڼا او نور معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: آفتابيا نوم د آفتاب څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د رڼا او نور دی، دا نوم هغه چا ته ورکړل کیږي چې په خپل ژوند کې د رڼا او نور سبب ګرځي، او په اسلامي دود کې د رڼا او نور اهميت په قرآن کريم کې يادونه شوې ده، لکه د نور سورت کې، او په سني حديث کې رسول الله صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم فرمايي: 'ته د الله په ځمکه کې نور يې'.

in_english.name: Aftabia
in_english.meaning: Derived from Aftab, meaning light and radiance
in_english.long_meaning: Aftabia is a name derived from Aftab, which means light and radiance. It is given to individuals who bring light and illumination into the lives of others. In Islamic tradition, the significance of light and radiance is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah An-Nur, and in the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him): 'You are the light of Allah on earth.' The name Aftabia symbolizes spiritual illumination and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aftabia holds a significant cultural impact in Persian and Islamic cultures, reflecting an individual's deep reverence for celestial bodies. The name originates from the Persian word "aftab," meaning "rising sun" or "sun disk," which is a symbol of resurrection and renewal in Islamic tradition. Naming an individual Aftabia implies a connection to this rich heritage, as well as a perception of the person as a beacon of hope and light in their community.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Aftabia signifies enlightenment and the radiant nature of the soul. It suggests that the individual carries a bright light within them, which can illuminate and inspire others. This name can serve as a constant reminder for the person to nurture their innate light and strive towards spiritual growth, making the world a brighter place for everyone. Additionally, the name may evoke the idea of the magnificent sun in the Islamic tradition, which is a symbol of God's boundless power and creativeness. Nurturing the inner light and connecting to this divine source of creation can deepen one's spiritual understanding and reverence for the sacred vibration of existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Morning Star" symbolizes The radiant one, the shining star, the one who appears before the sun. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aftabia serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of morning star.
